channel.title: Signature Assessments :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Signature assessments are the formal, high-stakes assessment events distributed across the program. Each is a culminating instance of a recurring assessment type — it represents that type at its most consequential, typically involving real artifacts, peer or faculty audience, and no scaffolding. Five formal, high-stakes signature events are distributed across the program, though not evenly: two converge on the same course (CIS 400), and one no longer fits inside the two-year core at all.
